    {"name": "submitted_off_hours", "analytical_usefulness": 0.5, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Off-hours flag derived from a timestamp (likely opened_at/processed_date).     {"name": "decline_risk_score", "analytical_usefulness": 0.6, "source_groundedness": 0.6, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "A composite score aggregating the other flags provides a convenient ranking axis, but it is largely a restatement/combination of already-added columns and its weighting is opaque; samples show it can be 0 even when component flags are set, raising derivation questions."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.68,
  "source_groundedness": 0.84,
  "rationale": "Most added columns provide genuine, distinct analytical axes for predicting travel-expense declines (user/department decline rates, relative-amount comparisons, missingness flags) and are soundly derivable from table fields; the missing/processed-date handling in the samples is correct. Weaknesses: submitted_off_hours is a fairly generic timestamp-derived flag with modest leverage, and decline_risk_score is largely a composite restatement of the other flags with an opaque, sometimes inconsistent derivation. Overall the set is useful and well grounded on the two necessary conditions."
